subject.title: Feature: Graph-aware loop detection for sessions_send (triangular/polygonal cascades bypass maxPingPongTurns)

question: Should `sessions_send` fail closed before delivery when a propagated inter-agent provenance chain would revisit an agent that already participated in the chain?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the fix intentionally changes existing cyclic multi-agent routes from delivered work into errors, which is a compatibility and product-policy choice.

options.title: Accept fail-closed cycle blocking
options.body: Land the linked guard after proof and conflict resolution so A -> B -> C -> A routes stop before the repeated agent run.

options.title: Preserve cyclic revisits
options.body: Reject or rework the guard if legitimate workflows need to revisit an agent in the same chain without an error.

options.title: Require an explicit route policy
options.body: Ask for an opt-in or thresholded route policy if maintainers want protection without changing existing revisit behavior by default.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed cycle blocking
recommendation.body: Land the linked guard after proof and conflict resolution so A -> B -> C -> A routes stop before the repeated agent run.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points to steipete as the strongest available owner for inter-session provenance and A2A lifecycle policy.
